<!doctype html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Plantilla interactiva · Espacios frente a Teatro Pavón</title>
<style>
:root {
  --gold:#E8C55A;
  --cream:#F5F0E4;
  --ink:#171310;
  --panel:#13100E;
  --muted:#C9B98F;
  --line:rgba(232,197,90,.34);
}
* { box-sizing:border-box; }
html,body { margin:0; }
body {
  font-family:Inter,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
  background:#1b1714;
  color:var(--cream);
}
.shell {
  min-height:100vh;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 340px;
}
.main {
  padding:26px 28px 32px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%, rgba(232,197,90,.09), transparent 30%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#211c18 0%,#181411 100%);
}
.side {
  padding:26px 22px 28px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#15120f 0%,#0f0d0b 100%);
  border-left:1px solid var(--line);
}
.topbar {
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:18px;
  margin-bottom:14px;
}
.eyebrow {
  margin:0 0 12px;
  color:var(--muted);
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.20em;
  font-size:13px;
  font-weight:900;
}
h1 {
  margin:0;
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,52px);
  line-height:.96;
  letter-spacing:-.045em;
  font-weight:900;
}
.brand {
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:9px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:999px;
  padding:9px 12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.brand img { width:19px;height:19px;object-fit:contain; }
.brand span {
  font-size:11px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  font-weight:800;
}
.tabs {
  display:flex;
  gap:12px;
  margin:18px 0 18px;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.tab {
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--cream);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  padding:14px 20px;
  border-radius:999px;
  cursor:pointer;
  font:900 14px/1 Inter,Arial,sans-serif;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(232,197,90,.05) inset;
  transition:all .22s ease;
}
.tab:hover {
  transform:translateY(-1px);
  border-color:var(--gold);
  box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,197,90,.18);
}
.tab.active {
  background:var(--gold);
  color:#171310;
  border-color:var(--gold);
}
.stage-card {
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:24px;
  padding:16px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.24);
}

.canvas-shell{
  width:88%;
  margin:0 auto;
  transition:width .15s ease;
}
.zoom-box{
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:14px;
  padding:11px 12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
  margin:0 0 14px;
}
.zoom-box label{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  color:var(--cream);
  font-size:11px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.12em;
  font-weight:900;
  margin-bottom:8px;
}
.zoom-box input[type=range]{
  width:100%;
}
.calendar-box{
  margin-top:16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(232,197,90,.18);
  border-radius:16px;
  padding:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);
}
.calendar-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:10px;
}
.calendar-head strong{
  color:var(--gold);
  font-size:11px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
}
.calendar-note{
  color:var(--muted);
  font-size:10px;
}
.calendar-grid{
  display:grid;
  gap:8px;
}
.calendar-row{
  border:1px solid rgba(232,197,90,.15);
  border-radius:12px;
  padding:9px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.015);
}
.calendar-space{
  color:var(--cream);
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:800;
  margin-bottom:7px;
}
.calendar-fields{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;
  gap:7px;
}
.calendar-fields input{
  width:100%;
  border:1px solid rgba(232,197,90,.18);
  background:#231d19;
  color:var(--cream);
  border-radius:9px;
  padding:8px 9px;
  font:600 11px/1.2 Inter,Arial,sans-serif;
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
  .canvas-shell{ width:94%; }
}
.view { display:none; }
.view.active { display:block; }
.stage {
  position:relative;
  width:100%;
  border-radius:16px;
  overflow:hidden;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  background-position:center;
  background-size:100% 100%;
}
#stage-taquilla {
  aspect-ratio:1448 / 1086;
  background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,
